16681b29451d7b7fc319233c725941211b02a03c.title: Fix crash approving message-signing requests
16681b29451d7b7fc319233c725941211b02a03c.oneLiner: Approving a message-signing request no longer crashes the SDK; the message is now left to be signed separately as intended.
16681b29451d7b7fc319233c725941211b02a03c.whyItMatters: Developers who approve message-sign or typed-data-sign requests through the SDK hit an error before this fix. Approvals for these requests now complete reliably, so message-signing workflows can proceed.

eadd38bdd98c16a07eb5babfbd1027116df3ab7c.title: New tokens: ZAR Universal on ARC and XRP
eadd38bdd98c16a07eb5babfbd1027116df3ab7c.oneLiner: Adds support for ZAR Universal on ARC and XRP, plus the Teuroc test token on Sepolia, with matching trading-account equivalents.
eadd38bdd98c16a07eb5babfbd1027116df3ab7c.whyItMatters: Client-requested tokens can now be recognized by wallets, pricing and the UI. Clients can hold and use ZAR Universal on two more networks.

3a58632da9b0dd92c6dfd89ade0fb40a05a76613.title: Safe wallet recovery across many coins
3a58632da9b0dd92c6dfd89ade0fb40a05a76613.oneLiner: Safe wallet keycards can now be used to recover funds on EVM chains, STX, AVAXC, Cosmos, SOL, ADA, XLM, XTZ, ICP, HBAR and ALGO.
3a58632da9b0dd92c6dfd89ade0fb40a05a76613.whyItMatters: Customers with Safe wallets can recover funds from a keycard on many more blockchains. Offline recovery doesn't auto-broadcast, and recovery fails safely when keys don't match.

45ec1fc323af0cca5d323100b0b695f6d3efc023.title: Automated token onboarding batch updates
45ec1fc323af0cca5d323100b0b695f6d3efc023.oneLiner: Several batches of new tokens were added through the automated asset-metadata onboarding process. The input doesn't name the specific tokens.
45ec1fc323af0cca5d323100b0b695f6d3efc023.whyItMatters: Newly onboarded tokens become recognized across BitGo wallets and trading accounts. The exact token list isn't stated, so check the individual changes for details.

76b196c46c9035efe32239a6a6f8df79ef307337.title: Fuller XLM transaction explanations before signing
76b196c46c9035efe32239a6a6f8df79ef307337.oneLiner: Stellar transaction explanations now show every account-settings change, such as signers, thresholds and home domain. They also flag operations the tool doesn't model.
76b196c46c9035efe32239a6a6f8df79ef307337.whyItMatters: Reviewers, for example in the offline vault console, can see everything a transaction does before signing. This lowers the risk of approving hidden changes.

0eecffce519513293e3844ceeba2886c4ca5f2f8.title: Zcash shielded transactions accept randomizer-only input
0eecffce519513293e3844ceeba2886c4ca5f2f8.oneLiner: Zcash shielded partially-signed transactions can now be built with a randomizer that supplies only the 'rk' value. The input gives no further detail.
0eecffce519513293e3844ceeba2886c4ca5f2f8.whyItMatters: This likely widens Zcash shielded transaction support. The purpose is not described in the input, so treat this reading as tentative.

32b38e566425a6626eb16957ee9d089435701798.title: Fix token setup for non-Ethereum EVM chains
32b38e566425a6626eb16957ee9d089435701798.oneLiner: Corrects how about 95 tokens on OKB X Layer, Base, and Flow are configured, so they use the right token type.
32b38e566425a6626eb16957ee9d089435701798.whyItMatters: Tokens set up with the wrong type could behave incorrectly or break the SDK when stricter checks are added. This keeps token support on these chains reliable for customers and their developers.

4d2f485168893235a3ceca717349f89dc7f42024.title: Fix Stellar token withdrawals with digits in name
4d2f485168893235a3ceca717349f89dc7f42024.oneLiner: Stellar tokens whose asset codes contain numbers, such as USDM1, are now accepted, so unsigned withdrawal transactions can be explained and processed in OVC.
4d2f485168893235a3ceca717349f89dc7f42024.whyItMatters: A client could not withdraw xlm:USDM1 from its Go account because the transaction failed validation in OVC. This unblocks withdrawals for Stellar tokens with alphanumeric codes.

80ae716a388cc4c6bafbb5d0891660e30580779d.title: Node.js 22 support deprecated in SDK
80ae716a388cc4c6bafbb5d0891660e30580779d.oneLiner: The SDK documentation now says Node.js 22 is deprecated ahead of its April 2027 end-of-life. Nothing is removed yet.
80ae716a388cc4c6bafbb5d0891660e30580779d.whyItMatters: Customer developers running the SDK on Node.js 22 get advance notice to plan an upgrade. Removal is tracked as a later follow-up.

b262172c6f5f44b65ec54bae6fbc7cbaa94565f6.title: Zcash Ironwood spend support
b262172c6f5f44b65ec54bae6fbc7cbaa94565f6.oneLiner: Adds building, inspecting and verifying Zcash Ironwood spend transactions, including keyless construction, TypeScript access and refreshed anchor and witness data on spends.
b262172c6f5f44b65ec54bae6fbc7cbaa94565f6.whyItMatters: This lays the groundwork for spending Zcash Ironwood funds through BitGo's SDK tooling. The input gives little customer-level detail, so scope and availability need confirming.

9907f7752bf49266de29ddfbbfd5f1264302b589.title: Fix ERC-7984 wrap approval rebuild verification
9907f7752bf49266de29ddfbbfd5f1264302b589.oneLiner: Fixes a failure where the server-side approval of a confidential-token wrap (ERC-7984) on onchain multisig wallets was rejected during verification.
9907f7752bf49266de29ddfbbfd5f1264302b589.whyItMatters: Pending approvals for wrapping confidential tokens could not be completed on onchain multisig wallets. The fix lets those approvals verify and go through.

bacde1ad294718516809b3519f92b44e71b703c3.title: Mainnet Zama confidential token shield/unshield enabled
bacde1ad294718516809b3519f92b44e71b703c3.oneLiner: Registers the on-chain details for six mainnet Zama confidential token pairs (ERC-7984) so wrap, approve and unwrap (shield/unshield) can work on production.
bacde1ad294718516809b3519f92b44e71b703c3.whyItMatters: Until now, shield and unshield requests on mainnet failed because the token pairs weren't registered. This is the SDK prerequisite for supporting Zama confidential tokens in production.

b49650c7c82c4263d15f1bdf11fb774cd9c19e1f.title: Zcash transaction checks for encrypted data and change
b49650c7c82c4263d15f1bdf11fb774cd9c19e1f.oneLiner: Adds verification of the encrypted cipher data and change output on Zcash transactions. Details are limited in the source.
b49650c7c82c4263d15f1bdf11fb774cd9c19e1f.whyItMatters: Stronger checks on Zcash transactions help confirm funds go where intended, including change returning to the wallet. Exact scope is unclear from the input.

f2aad30bef39a96511c855bf0dca407b3cddbfd0.title: Fix Go Account naming for Solana OpenUSD
f2aad30bef39a96511c855bf0dca407b3cddbfd0.oneLiner: Corrects the Go Account naming used for the OpenUSD token on Solana.
f2aad30bef39a96511c855bf0dca407b3cddbfd0.whyItMatters: Accurate account naming keeps OpenUSD on Solana displaying and behaving consistently for Go Account users. Details are limited in the source.

ef6099a40c5a74a1b13a8910ef00679f5a01a015.title: Fix ERC-7984 wrap/unwrap on custodial multisig wallets
ef6099a40c5a74a1b13a8910ef00679f5a01a015.oneLiner: Fixes wrap, unwrap and finalize-unwrap for ERC-7984 tokens on Ethereum-family multisig wallets, including approving them as pending approvals and building them through the API.
ef6099a40c5a74a1b13a8910ef00679f5a01a015.whyItMatters: These operations previously failed with missing-parameter or schema errors. Customers using ERC-7984 confidential tokens can now complete wrap and unwrap flows, including approval of pending requests.

da70014b9936cc57cd2d22b118f724629d5f3aab.title: Pass attestation through withdrawals and MPC signing
da70014b9936cc57cd2d22b118f724629d5f3aab.oneLiner: The SDK and Express now accept an optional attestation on withdrawal and threshold-signing requests and pass it along to BitGo. They do not verify it.
da70014b9936cc57cd2d22b118f724629d5f3aab.whyItMatters: Developers can attach attestation data to withdrawals and signing requests. This is groundwork for services that need it. The purpose of the attestation is not stated in the source.

b9c74d38febf70ef4ece39196e9794a08cd8f21c.title: Zcash v6 transaction size calculation support
b9c74d38febf70ef4ece39196e9794a08cd8f21c.oneLiner: Zcash v6 (Ironwood) unsigned transactions can now be extracted correctly, so their size can be calculated instead of failing.
b9c74d38febf70ef4ece39196e9794a08cd8f21c.whyItMatters: This enables a more accurate fee check on pending approvals for Zcash v6 transactions. It replaces an approximate size measure and may later support integrity checks.

442b7b89ba3a48f92c7bc2b1e553ee567e5692a6.title: Support for Node.js 26 in SDK
442b7b89ba3a48f92c7bc2b1e553ee567e5692a6.oneLiner: The BitGo SDK now works on Node.js 26, including a fix for Cardano message signing that broke on that version.
442b7b89ba3a48f92c7bc2b1e553ee567e5692a6.whyItMatters: Customers' developers can run the SDK on the newest Node.js version. Without the Cardano fix, message encoding on Node.js 26 would have been silently cut short and failed to decode.

c69fb40a720c667e0c1003bd739e1eaeb10b0ea6.title: Shielded Zcash transactions for MPC wallets
c69fb40a720c667e0c1003bd739e1eaeb10b0ea6.oneLiner: Adds keyless building and parsing of shielded Zcash transactions for MPC Zcash wallets. The PR gives no further detail.
c69fb40a720c667e0c1003bd739e1eaeb10b0ea6.whyItMatters: This likely extends shielded Zcash support to MPC wallets. The source is a title only, so the exact customer impact is unclear.

77b29063455ada0f5e9379bc4e489ab8764dc4f0.title: Unified addresses on Zcash transparent outputs
77b29063455ada0f5e9379bc4e489ab8764dc4f0.oneLiner: Zcash version 6 partially signed transactions now accept unified addresses on their transparent outputs.
77b29063455ada0f5e9379bc4e489ab8764dc4f0.whyItMatters: This likely lets customers send to Zcash unified addresses in more transaction types. The source is a title only, so confidence is low.

f94685f739bad995d43b5b5ce5aa2f8bcc2ecb41.title: Read spent inputs from Zcash v6 transactions
f94685f739bad995d43b5b5ce5aa2f8bcc2ecb41.oneLiner: Adds a lower-level function to list the previous outputs a transaction spends. Version 6 Zcash transactions now behave like version 4 when pending approvals are created.
f94685f739bad995d43b5b5ce5aa2f8bcc2ecb41.whyItMatters: Pending-approval creation for version 6 Zcash transactions works consistently with older versions. This is mostly internal plumbing, and customers would only notice it as reliability.

8010477343f724619bb1c2e3b137ce28e26db181.title: Safer PoX-5 early exits for custodial wallets
8010477343f724619bb1c2e3b137ce28e26db181.oneLiner: Offline vault and descriptor wallets now check spend rules and can explain and half-sign PoX-5 early exits before signing.
8010477343f724619bb1c2e3b137ce28e26db181.whyItMatters: Customers can exit PoX-5 lockups early using the Offline Vault Console. Added checks before signing help prevent invalid or unsafe spends, for both early and late exits.

d9a409545239faa3465b6aec4fae94d199525864.title: ZAMA staking available for Ethereum wallets
d9a409545239faa3465b6aec4fae94d199525864.oneLiner: ZAMA now appears in the Stake asset picker for Ethereum wallets in production, so customers can select it for staking.
d9a409545239faa3465b6aec4fae94d199525864.whyItMatters: Mainnet ZAMA was filtered out of the Stake picker even though backend staking support existed. Customers with the staking flag enabled can now start ZAMA staking from the UI.

ebf33058c287e468a6adbe60889e0f5b7e32172b.title: Canton custodial timing data kept in transactions
ebf33058c287e468a6adbe60889e0f5b7e32172b.oneLiner: The SDK now preserves custodial ledger-time metadata when serializing Canton transactions for broadcast.
ebf33058c287e468a6adbe60889e0f5b7e32172b.whyItMatters: Keeping timing metadata intact helps Canton custodial transactions broadcast correctly. The input gives limited detail, so the exact customer impact is unclear.

99c0c1b447a2d22b2be6273ae65309e838ccb42c.title: Fix wallet share acceptance failure for some users
99c0c1b447a2d22b2be6273ae65309e838ccb42c.oneLiner: Bulk accepting wallet shares no longer looks up the sharing key when it isn't needed, fixing an error for users without one.
99c0c1b447a2d22b2be6273ae65309e838ccb42c.whyItMatters: Users with no sharing key on file, such as those accepting Go Account or OFC rotation shares, hit a confusing 'encryptedXprv not found' error. They can now accept these shares.

197c530daf35359e5840436339207e50a5194bef.title: Stacks staking supports configured PoX-5 contracts
197c530daf35359e5840436339207e50a5194bef.oneLiner: The Stacks SDK can now build and accept transactions for a configured PoX-5 staking contract, including the test and dummy contracts, with safeguards.
197c530daf35359e5840436339207e50a5194bef.whyItMatters: Registering for Stacks PoX-5 bonding was blocked because the contract wasn't the canonical one. Custody and offline vault signing and wallet platform flows can now handle it. Allowances are set in the SDK, are pair-specific and expire.

2e03c9f1363e6baac748197c6f0a311aaf75eee0.title: Corrected Canton test token contract addresses
2e03c9f1363e6baac748197c6f0a311aaf75eee0.oneLiner: Contract addresses for 499 Canton test tokens were updated to match the official token export.
2e03c9f1363e6baac748197c6f0a311aaf75eee0.whyItMatters: Accurate contract addresses help Canton test tokens resolve and transact correctly. Only the address format changed; no tokens were added and non-Canton tokens were untouched.

638b5ee3034cfb944738de1b406c3e84289e222b.title: Canton Broadridge delegation and settlement support
638b5ee3034cfb944738de1b406c3e84289e222b.oneLiner: The SDK now supports Broadridge standing delegation on Canton, plus allocation and settlement authorization flows and receive-only allocations for cross-issuer trades.
638b5ee3034cfb944738de1b406c3e84289e222b.whyItMatters: Lets customers' developers build and sign Broadridge-related Canton transactions, including cross-issuer delivery-versus-payment settlements, through the BitGo SDK. This extends BitGo's Canton coverage for institutional settlement workflows.

74b89295324db3a401a5895d88d3e83c4123b70e.title: Message signing finalization fix, then reverted
74b89295324db3a401a5895d88d3e83c4123b70e.oneLiner: A fix to how message signing finishes for DeFi policy flows was merged, then reverted. The net result is no change.
74b89295324db3a401a5895d88d3e83c4123b70e.whyItMatters: The fix addressed an error after approval and re-sign of message-signing requests. Since it was reverted, the issue may still be open. The reason for the revert isn't stated.

ccef0304160507dc03566cc71a1e2f02384fe87a.title: Fix beta release preparation step
ccef0304160507dc03566cc71a1e2f02384fe87a.oneLiner: Internal release tooling now skips a private, unpublished package so beta release preparation no longer fails.
ccef0304160507dc03566cc71a1e2f02384fe87a.whyItMatters: Keeps the internal beta release process running reliably. No customer-visible change.

0273fc8e79ebb803543d5c325ca8cdd7de8f66ed.title: Fix weekly dependency-pruning automation
0273fc8e79ebb803543d5c325ca8cdd7de8f66ed.oneLiner: An internal weekly cleanup job was failing because of an outdated AI model setting. It now uses a newer model.
0273fc8e79ebb803543d5c325ca8cdd7de8f66ed.whyItMatters: Keeps internal maintenance automation running. No customer impact.

9e187d1112e569b1b4b9e2809e8fb9d10710c5e0.title: Advanced wallets Node runtime upgrade
9e187d1112e569b1b4b9e2809e8fb9d10710c5e0.oneLiner: The advanced wallets service runtime was upgraded to a newer Node version, with security fixes and updated documentation.
9e187d1112e569b1b4b9e2809e8fb9d10710c5e0.whyItMatters: Keeps the service on a supported, patched runtime. Customers who self-host should note the updated Node prerequisite in the README.

d17be85fd321fd106ac4523f0e628002c2275d2b.title: Express Docker image moves to Node 24
d17be85fd321fd106ac4523f0e628002c2275d2b.oneLiner: The BitGo Express Docker image now runs on Node 24 instead of Node 22, matching the version used in the project's own configuration.
d17be85fd321fd106ac4523f0e628002c2275d2b.whyItMatters: Customers who self-host the image get a newer runtime. The PR flags this as a major-version change that could affect native modules, so self-hosting customers should test before upgrading.

74689185d92c9ba3d8f52281c4dbc7ce118158a5.title: Express no longer hangs on failed sends
74689185d92c9ba3d8f52281c4dbc7ce118158a5.oneLiner: Fixes a bug where BitGo Express never replied when a send failed partway, leaving clients with a 503 timeout. Errors now return properly.
74689185d92c9ba3d8f52281c4dbc7ce118158a5.whyItMatters: Developers now get a clear error when a send fails, rather than a hanging request and timeout. This makes failed sends easier to diagnose and handle.

9efcfeb999ebeadf44a51d03d18e05c72b332f46.title: XLM and HBAR recovery supports external signers
9efcfeb999ebeadf44a51d03d18e05c72b332f46.oneLiner: Stellar (XLM) and Hedera (HBAR) wallet recovery now uses a shared external signer, and a backup key is optional when one is supplied.
9efcfeb999ebeadf44a51d03d18e05c72b332f46.whyItMatters: Customers can sign recovery transactions with their own external signing setup instead of handing over a backup key. A safeguard also stops signed data from being altered after signing.

f60d39db6549660ddcc6204f028f34b7d7ff7707.title: UTXO library: checked randomizer and signing path
f60d39db6549660ddcc6204f028f34b7d7ff7707.oneLiner: Internal update to the UTXO WASM library that consolidates randomizer handling and spend-signature creation into one checked path. The PR gives no further detail.
f60d39db6549660ddcc6204f028f34b7d7ff7707.whyItMatters: The purpose is unclear from the input. It looks like groundwork for shielded-transaction support, but that is not confirmed, so it isn't clearly customer-visible.

1a76bc7660161449f8cd06a3948d22a2ad117eca.title: UTXO library: KMS ciphertext and proof helpers
1a76bc7660161449f8cd06a3948d22a2ad117eca.oneLiner: Adds helper functions to the UTXO WASM library for KMS output ciphertext and proofs. The PR gives no further detail.
1a76bc7660161449f8cd06a3948d22a2ad117eca.whyItMatters: The purpose is unclear from the input. It appears to be developer-level groundwork rather than a change customers would see directly.

0d8aec8c58ef35281273f016e20f8d77a11f1ed8.title: Grass (Solana) token support for Go Accounts
0d8aec8c58ef35281273f016e20f8d77a11f1ed8.oneLiner: Adds the Grass token on Solana to Go Accounts so incoming Grass deposits can be credited to the customer's account.
0d8aec8c58ef35281273f016e20f8d77a11f1ed8.whyItMatters: Before this, Grass deposits arrived as unmatched deposits and couldn't be credited to Go Accounts. Customers can now hold and use Grass there. Rollout still needs a statics publish and a Prime release.

ba584eb797465aad128283e1119268e2b6210de5.title: Zcash NU7 network upgrade support
ba584eb797465aad128283e1119268e2b6210de5.oneLiner: Prepares Zcash wallets and recovery for the NU7 network upgrade, expected around 5 Nov 2026, using the correct transaction format after activation.
ba584eb797465aad128283e1119268e2b6210de5.whyItMatters: Without this, Zcash transactions and recoveries made after the upgrade could be signed but fail to broadcast. It keeps ZEC transfers and recovery working through the network change.

be6140c56fd1e3c5cb9aa8348a79d7cd2208d11f.title: Generic parsed-input types for UTXO library
be6140c56fd1e3c5cb9aa8348a79d7cd2208d11f.oneLiner: Adds shared internal data types for reading transaction inputs, including Zcash-specific ones, in the UTXO library. The PR gives no more detail.
be6140c56fd1e3c5cb9aa8348a79d7cd2208d11f.whyItMatters: This looks like developer-facing groundwork for Zcash and UTXO handling. The input has no description, so the customer impact is unclear.

f2a8b541aba25f10dfb4c0f801e186970cafe215.title: Solana v1 transaction version now honored in SDK
f2a8b541aba25f10dfb4c0f801e186970cafe215.oneLiner: The SDK now passes a requested Solana transaction version (v0 or v1) through to the wallet platform. Before, it silently dropped the setting.
f2a8b541aba25f10dfb4c0f801e186970cafe215.whyItMatters: Developers asking for Solana v1 payments always got v0 transactions with no error or warning. This fix lets integrators build the transaction version they request.

060cf377675591fb50cff9a72078fa0f5f71c056.title: Fix token test for cross-chain address reuse
060cf377675591fb50cff9a72078fa0f5f71c056.oneLiner: Corrects an internal test that wrongly rejected the same token contract address on different blockchains.
060cf377675591fb50cff9a72078fa0f5f71c056.whyItMatters: This is a test-only change, so customers see no effect. It stops false failures when the same token address legitimately appears on more than one chain.

b8751b8870f080cd67c93bc93f5203b877210843.title: SUI recovery and sweep move to gRPC
b8751b8870f080cd67c93bc93f5203b877210843.oneLiner: The SDK now talks to SUI nodes over gRPC instead of the deprecated JSON-RPC, keeping SUI recovery and sweep flows working.
b8751b8870f080cd67c93bc93f5203b877210843.whyItMatters: Sui is retiring JSON-RPC and public providers will follow. Without this change, SUI recovery and sweep flows would break. Developers get a new per-environment gRPC endpoint setting.

5ce4032fb3818cb24230107c6fef4a81bffe3462.title: Pass Hardhat config secrets as environment variables
5ce4032fb3818cb24230107c6fef4a81bffe3462.oneLiner: Internal fix so all secrets used by the Ethereum multisig contract tooling configuration are supplied as environment variables.
5ce4032fb3818cb24230107c6fef4a81bffe3462.whyItMatters: Internal build and deployment tooling change. No direct customer impact is described.

6b88909245d32843f513aac879f23cb848df944b.title: Fix TIA withdrawals to memo-tagged recipients
6b88909245d32843f513aac879f23cb848df944b.oneLiner: Withdrawals of TIA (Celestia) to recipients with a memo no longer fail local validation with a false outputs-mismatch error.
6b88909245d32843f513aac879f23cb848df944b.whyItMatters: Memo-tagged addresses are common for exchange deposits. Before the fix, these TIA withdrawals were wrongly rejected, even though the built transaction was correct. Customers can now send them.

d33734176531827238d2f5affbf5265a64062960.title: Solana confidential transfer token enablement
d33734176531827238d2f5affbf5265a64062960.oneLiner: Token enablement in the SDK now supports Solana confidential transfers. It can create the token account and configure it for confidential transfers in one transaction.
d33734176531827238d2f5affbf5265a64062960.whyItMatters: Customers' developers can enable Solana tokens for confidential transfers with a single transaction. It also fixes an instruction layout issue in the account configuration step and adds an opt-out flag.

a7bfec805328f52667a9eba2a7e0eb9434f447de.title: EdDSA MPCv2 signing in Advanced Wallets
a7bfec805328f52667a9eba2a7e0eb9434f447de.oneLiner: Master Express now supports signing for EdDSA wallets on the newer MPCv2 protocol. It automatically routes to the right flow based on wallet version.
a7bfec805328f52667a9eba2a7e0eb9434f447de.whyItMatters: EdDSA MPCv2 wallets can sign transactions through the external signer setup. Existing MPCv1 EdDSA wallets and ECDSA wallets continue to work as before.

8eb84a82bfd6e173db21dabde4199b8ee102f241.title: Change safe MPC child key derivation encoding
8eb84a82bfd6e173db21dabde4199b8ee102f241.oneLiner: The path used to derive safe child keys for MPC wallets is now encoded as UTF-8 text bytes. Key creation and offline recovery both use it.
8eb84a82bfd6e173db21dabde4199b8ee102f241.whyItMatters: Every party must use the same encoding, or the derived child keys differ. This keeps key creation and offline recovery consistent. Teams should check compatibility with any previously derived keys.

e4b396dd7bf23538d8887d98ccc605d1280188ea.title: ERC-7984 shield/unshield checks for multisig ETH wallets
e4b396dd7bf23538d8887d98ccc605d1280188ea.oneLiner: Adds transaction verification safeguards so custodial Ethereum multi-signature wallets can safely perform ERC-7984 shield and unshield operations, including approval checks and rejection of unexpected recipients.
e4b396dd7bf23538d8887d98ccc605d1280188ea.whyItMatters: Extends confidential-token shield/unshield support to custodial ETH multi-sig wallets. The added checks help block tampered or mislabeled approvals before signing, which reduces the risk of a compromised server altering a transaction.

1b99338646efb3f13b4f257da833c874d02f65b0.title: EdDSA MPCv2 signing in advanced wallets
1b99338646efb3f13b4f257da833c874d02f65b0.oneLiner: Adds EdDSA multi-party signing support, in three rounds, to the master Express service for advanced wallets, mirroring the existing ECDSA flow.
1b99338646efb3f13b4f257da833c874d02f65b0.whyItMatters: Lets advanced wallets sign with EdDSA-based assets using the newer MPC protocol. Out-of-order signing rounds produce clear errors. Customer impact is inferred from the PR description and may be limited to self-hosted setups.

04779389a658f4871f8938a013ac0db1310208e6.title: Fix broken HyperEVM testnet explorer links
04779389a658f4871f8938a013ac0db1310208e6.oneLiner: HyperEVM testnet (thype) transaction and address links now open hyperscan.sh. The old explorer shut down, so those links returned 404 errors.
04779389a658f4871f8938a013ac0db1310208e6.whyItMatters: Users and developers can view testnet transactions and addresses again. The new explorer's indexer may lag, according to a caveat in the PR.

5fb855b4216549f7651a857b3dc254acf815000f.title: Canton participant allow-list command builders
5fb855b4216549f7651a857b3dc254acf815000f.oneLiner: Adds SDK helpers to build Canton v3 commands that add or remove wallets on a participant's allow-list, using end-investor credentials.
5fb855b4216549f7651a857b3dc254acf815000f.whyItMatters: Lets developers manage allow-lists for DTCC Canton v3 participants in code, with identifier validation. This supports regulated, permissioned Canton workflows.

23244d5b3010f50f16d76ef805d4fd9d9d38d6c4.title: Multi-spend shielded Zcash signing support
23244d5b3010f50f16d76ef805d4fd9d9d38d6c4.oneLiner: Updates the signing logic for shielded Zcash transactions so one transaction can sign several spends at once, instead of only one.
23244d5b3010f50f16d76ef805d4fd9d9d38d6c4.whyItMatters: Supports onboarding of Zcash privacy transactions that need multiple spends. The PR cites a critical delivery timeline.

ccb7c0268f100f9195627e14ebf573c23a7e1f8d: Confidential tokens (ERC-7984): shield and unshield now work on mainnet for six Zama token pairs, with new safety checks and fixes for multisig wallets. ZAMA can also be staked on Ethereum wallets.
Wallet recovery widened: Safe wallet keycards now recover funds across many chains, including EVM, SOL, ADA and XLM. XLM and HBAR recovery also supports external signers.
Stacks staking: the SDK now supports configured PoX-5 contracts, and offline vault and descriptor wallets can check and half-sign PoX-5 early exits before signing.
New asset support: ZAR Universal on ARC and XRP, plus the Grass token on Solana for Go Accounts, so incoming Grass deposits can be credited.

Fuller Stellar transaction explanations before signing: every account-settings change is now shown, and unsupported operations are flagged. Stellar tokens with digits in their names now work for withdrawals.
